versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the summarize skill.
- Summarize URLs, local files (including PDF, images, audio), and YouTube links via the summarize CLI.
- Supports multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google) with configurable API keys and default model.
- Includes various output and extraction options: customizable summary length, output format (JSON), and extraction methods.
- Offers optional configuration file and fallback services for broader compatibility.
